input: Only the canonical compact seal produced from selected source-only input; no gold, label, future event or inferred source selection.
support_aliases: Seal order; every source with ownership new or overlap. Use exact aliases as enum values in each existing closed sources reference alternative.
context_aliases: Seal order; only sources with ownership context. Use exact aliases as enum values in each existing closed context reference alternative.
empty_support: Require candidates const[] when no supporting alias exists; never emit empty enums.
template: The pinned unchanged compact-v2 closed-reference schema. Preserve every property except reference alias enums and required-empty arrays.
system_prompt: Pinned prompt.txt prefix concatenated with complete derived schema encoded by Go encoding/json; same derived schema is passed in format.
request_identity: Record actual system/schema SHA256 and derivation version alongside the unchanged seal and exact request. Report top-level prompt/schema hashes name pinned base files.
scoring: Reconstruct exact per-window schema/system/request from the reviewed corpus and pinned base files; reject edited aliases/schema/prompt even when local request hashes are recomputed.
unchanged: Strict subject/object identity, range/UTF-8/source/clock checks, scope, authority, response binding and raw denominators; no repairs or semantic credit from schema membership.
